//TR: Bu checkpoint dependency-aware gate sonrası current-truth belgelerinin ve pinlenmiş doc-truth validator sabitlerinin Founder yetkili senkronunu, bağımsız review kayıtlarının kalıcılaştırılmasını ve açık TRUST-F1 bulgusunu kaydeder; CLEAN, final closure veya target-machine Phase0 PASS iddiası değildir.

founderAuthorization.rule: (a) CANONICAL-STATUS.md is updated to the new truth: lock present, canonical 34/34, independent review CLEAN. (b) The pinned scope/status expectations in validate-paste4c-doc-truth.mjs move to the new state; all overclaim checks (SOURCE_LEVEL_CLOSURE=false, seal, Phase0, ZIP) stay unchanged. (c) In validate-paste4d-release-truth.mjs only the two pinned constants move to the new truth (dependency-aware PASS and the open-finding record); all overclaim checks (source closure false, seal, SHA256SUMS, release authenticity, ZIP, Phase0) stay unchanged. Non-protected state files and the review records belong to the same package.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.

validationEnvironment.measuredBy: scripts/preflight.mjs on this machine; re-measured and required to match before each isolated validation run

implementation.paste4c: progress.fullSystemReaudit.status, progress.nextScope, currentAudit.activeScope and the NEXT_ACTIONS scope move to the new state; pack.staticClosureAudit gains DEPENDENCY_AWARE_SOURCE_VALIDATION_COMPLETE_TARGET_PHASE0_PENDING; a new check requires DEPENDENCY_AWARE_ENVIRONMENT_GATE_REVIEWED_LOCK in completedSourceScopes; every overclaim check is unchanged.
implementation.paste4d: TEST_STATUS must now state DEPENDENCY_AWARE_VALIDATION = PASS_TARGET_WINDOWS_NODE24_NPM11; overallRemainingP0P1P2 gains P1_OPEN_TRUST_F1_DEPENDENCY_AWARE_PASS_PENDING_FOUNDER_DECISION. At approval time the open finding was PKGC-F1 (since closed by PKG-E); the open finding recorded now is TRUST-F1. No ZERO value for the dependency-aware state was added because a P1 is open.
implementation.reviewRecords: audit/reviews/ holds one record per Codex run: frozen bundle, unchanged reviewer output as text with SHA-256, run manifest, governed evaluation or environment-block record; unsigned until the Phase0 evidence signing key exists.

openFindings.observed: Every protected prefix is matched as a directory (p===prefix || p.startsWith(prefix+'/')), so the filename prefix 'scripts/validate-' in config/protected-paths.json protects nothing: 26 of 27 scripts/validate-*.mjs validators are not flagged by the change guard and not expected in the trust-root manifest (only validate-domain-packs.mjs is protected, through exactPaths).
openFindings.discoveredDuring: V6-PKG-E2 bundle generation (change guard reported no protected change for scripts/validate-tr-comments.mjs)

lowBacklog.observed: verifyProvisionedElectron authenticates every dist file against the archive but never reads manifest.exeSha256; metadata consistency only.
